The Wind in the Willows.why: 'Hang spring-cleaning!' no original nao e 'said the Mole' (e narrado: 'and also Hang spring-cleaning!'); tirada a atribuicao dita
lines: The Mole had been working very hard all the morning, spring-cleaning his little home.
A Toupeira trabalhara muito durante toda a manhã, fazendo a faxina de primavera em sua casinha.
Ao diabo com a faxina de primavera!

The Wind in the Willows: Summer Days.why: original: 'absolute nothing' e 'that's the best of it'; corrigido
lines: Believe me, my young friend, there is nothing—absolute nothing—half so much worth doing as simply messing about in boats.
Acredite, meu jovem amigo, não há nada, absolutamente nada, que valha tanto a pena quanto simplesmente passear de barco.
Nothing seems really to matter, that’s the best of it.
Nada parece realmente importar, e essa é a melhor parte.

Wee Willie Winkie.why: ultimo verso varia (eight/ten o'clock, in bed/beds); redacao nao certa

Winnie-the-Pooh.why: traducao errada de 'on the back of his head' (de costas)
lines: Here is Edward Bear, coming downstairs now, bump, bump, bump, on the back of his head, behind Christopher Robin.
Aqui está Edward Bear, descendo as escadas agora, bum, bum, bum, com a nuca batendo nos degraus, atrás de Christopher Robin.
It is, as far as he knows, the only way of coming downstairs.
Até onde ele sabe, é o único jeito de descer escadas.
